race.comment: LIGHT MOVES (11) profiles as a key hope after a first-up second at Mornington, where he was beaten a long neck despite interference on the home turn and being held up approaching the 200m. He is already a winner at this track and distance, and up to 1400m suits ideally. ZOURAIN (1) is the obvious danger after winning by a length at this track and trip in a BM62, with the 3kg claim helping against the heavier impost. SUMO SANDY (4) was solid when third first-up in a BM70 at Cranbourne and has a strong record at 1400m, so he can be sharper second-up. LET IT BEEL (8) is going okay and will run well again.
